texts.zh:
我们在[from.target.capital_scope.GetName]上的工作遇到了一个很怪的难题：[from.target.GetSpeciesAdj]蜂巢正在镜像模仿我们的行为。一开始我们以为不过是当地工蜂的古怪行为，但许多这些新的习惯毫无疑问本质上就是[from.owner.GetSpeciesAdj]的。

这不仅暗示了我们在[from.GetName]行动缜密设计的范围之外影响到了当地的蜂巢，更提醒了我们自己的失败融入正在被倒映回给我们。目前没有迹象表明这个蜂巢意识到了我们的行动，但也许我们的暴露与否只是时间问题。
texts.en:
Our work on [from.target.capital_scope.GetName] has met with an unusual complication: the [from.target.GetSpeciesAdj] hive is mirroring our behavior. At first we thought the local drones had simply turned eccentric, but many of these new habits are unmistakeably [from.owner.GetSpeciesAdj] in nature.

Not only does this suggest we are influencing the hive outside the carefully-planned remit of Operation [from.GetName], but our own failures to blend in are now being reflected back us. There are no signs yet that the hive is aware of our operation, but that may only be a matter of time.

label.zh: 所以他们变得……更好控制了？

tooltips.zh: 增大在我们的谍报行动过程中[from.target.GetName]获得£awareness£觉醒的风险。
tooltips.en: Increased risk of the [from.target.GetName] gaining £awareness£ Awareness during our Espionage Operations.

tooltips.zh: 调配更多资源，确保抑制我们特工的本能和不当习惯。
tooltips.en: Assign more resources to keeping our operatives' instincts and mannerisms in check.

label.zh: 我们就坚持一下做到底。
label.en: We are committed to seeing this through.
